oracle.method: conjugate algebra from declared design matrices
oracle.independence_basis: Exact rational conjugate algebra on rows rebuilt from the declared designs: Gaussian posterior mean and variance, the five-column quadratic-basis normal-inverse-gamma coefficient means, precision inverse, shape, scale and effect variance, and the joint internal [T,1] posterior from precision [[128.01,128],[128,256.25]] and moment [384,512]. The generator rebuilds the design rows, solves the normal equations exactly and forms the posterior moments; it imports no Antecedent code and draws nothing. The asserting tests also restate parts of this algebra in floating point, so the comparison here is the exact-arithmetic version of the same conjugate formulas: independence is of implementation, not of the Bayesian-linear-model theory.
asserted_outputs: quadratic-basis treatment coefficient mean and effect variance
joint internal posterior mean and variance
context_only_outputs: prior_transfer source/target effects (declared structural effects used as a bracket)
quadratic precision_inverse, nig_shape and nig_scale entries not read by an executing assertion (verified here)
oracle.historical_exposure: Written during this review from the fixture README and the asserting tests (which restate the algebra); no product implementation source was consulted. Authorship of the original algebra is unrecorded.
